quality_rule: M1 ignores an exercise result whose status is not SUCCESS/OK/COMPLETE.
running_note: A physically measured 50 m course is required. The current implementation uses operator S/F timing with CV movement/step validation; a single laptop camera cannot independently verify 50 m distance.
vertical_jump_note: Single-camera jump height is calibrated from athlete height and is an estimate. Validate against a measured reference before official use.
deadlift_note: Use an expert-approved standard load, correct equipment, and trained supervision.
